revisions.owner_action: On the handset open Terminal and Settings from the home grid and confirm both render real content; after one normal reboot confirm the launcher is still the current bundle (docs/beta-finalization/manual-proof/02-launcher.md). The VM parity run itself is owned by bg-11-vm-parity
revisions.note: No new launcher: the existing PWA is extended. pwa/nuxel-home (index/css/js/manifest/sw) is the single source of truth; the stale device copies (status-bar.js v0.3.2, old manifest.json, missing Terminal) are fixed, the SW cache key was bumped to v4-a33 so a stale bundle is invalidated deterministically (the A32 cache-invalidation behaviour is preserved and INV-1 still guards it), Terminal was added to the registry and nuxel-settings now has a runnable frontend. VM parity belongs to bg-11 (ceiling VERIFIED_IN_VM_ONLY); on-glass parity remains NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.
